### Minor Changes

- [#11](https://github.com/valeriobelli/opencode-openrouter-budget/pull/11) [`5f7dcf4`](https://github.com/valeriobelli/opencode-openrouter-budget/commit/5f7dcf4259024be7368244cbf7e8881db94682a8) Thanks [@valeriobelli](https://github.com/valeriobelli)! - Make the `/openrouter-budget` dialog readable in narrow terminals:

  - Each request takes one line, in aligned columns that adapt to the dialog's width.
  - Spend and limits sit in two sections, with each figure shown once.
  - The request list scrolls with ↑↓, PgUp/PgDn, Home/End and the mouse wheel, while the summary and the key hints stay on screen.
  - Day headings separate requests made on different days.
  - Unknown BYOK costs are marked with `?` or `unknown`.
  - The dialog opens wide and centred, as intended. Before, it always opened at OpenCode's medium width of 60 columns, because its size was set before the dialog was shown.
  - `r` now refreshes the wallet while the dialog is open.

### Patch Changes

- [#12](https://github.com/valeriobelli/opencode-openrouter-budget/pull/12) [`9889244`](https://github.com/valeriobelli/opencode-openrouter-budget/commit/9889244147b51a769b2bf5c4b847536c7848fdd3) Thanks [@valeriobelli](https://github.com/valeriobelli)! - `/openrouter-budget` now shows its "OpenRouter budget unavailable" error toast when the session summary cannot be loaded. Before, the failure was silent.

### Minor Changes

- [#9](https://github.com/valeriobelli/opencode-openrouter-budget/pull/9) [`8ea9ea6`](https://github.com/valeriobelli/opencode-openrouter-budget/commit/8ea9ea6ac4d707cdd33f372fc450b81526f6188a) Thanks [@valeriobelli](https://github.com/valeriobelli)! - Report BYOK spend separately from OpenRouter's own charge. BYOK requests return `usage.cost: 0` with the provider's charge in `cost_details.upstream_inference_cost`, so sessions using your own provider keys showed `$0.00`. The sidebar now shows the session total and its OpenRouter + BYOK split, and `/openrouter-budget` lists both per request and shows whether BYOK counts toward the key limit and the effective budget. Requests without BYOK data are shown as unknown rather than zero.

### Patch Changes

- [#7](https://github.com/valeriobelli/opencode-openrouter-budget/pull/7) [`4d6b146`](https://github.com/valeriobelli/opencode-openrouter-budget/commit/4d6b1465589b75589b0600da933971393ce98db6) Thanks [@suxatcode](https://github.com/suxatcode)! - Fetch the OpenRouter wallet when the cache is empty. The poll returned immediately whenever a refresh was required, so key budget and account credits never loaded.

### Minor Changes

- [`de4bfe8`](https://github.com/valeriobelli/opencode-openrouter-budget/commit/de4bfe8421dfdbb35147cafded157e51e8d0873c) Thanks [@valeriobelli](https://github.com/valeriobelli)! - Define dependencies as expected to allow OpenCode to download them

### Patch Changes

- [`8e64cdd`](https://github.com/valeriobelli/opencode-openrouter-budget/commit/8e64cdd14a7c6a00ab408a453d909ab5e89f84d1) Thanks [@valeriobelli](https://github.com/valeriobelli)! - Define peers as expected

### Patch Changes

- [`c6177cd`](https://github.com/valeriobelli/opencode-openrouter-budget/commit/c6177cd304fa1c9a5e4125e7007436dedfc8f3d6) Thanks [@valeriobelli](https://github.com/valeriobelli)! - Remove some slop from the code

- [`6149929`](https://github.com/valeriobelli/opencode-openrouter-budget/commit/6149929b7e6ae8e4fa842fffcbcc73a99cd94853) Thanks [@valeriobelli](https://github.com/valeriobelli)! - fix: use single-line @jsxImportSource pragma for bun+node_modules—block form triggers newline in import path, breaking the load. This matches all working OpenCode TUI plugins and is proven in Bun upstream tests.

### Patch Changes

- [`da60654`](https://github.com/valeriobelli/opencode-openrouter-budget/commit/da6065400c30af45e1d20308d0bab283206673ea) Thanks [@valeriobelli](https://github.com/valeriobelli)! - Fix the TUI entry when installed from npm: Bun ignores tsconfig.json inside node_modules, so the JSX pragma now selects the OpenTUI runtime explicitly.
